name: David Cienfuegos
office: Beverly Hills Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: David Cienfuegos is a trial attorney at a personal injury law firm. He says he holds degrees from California State University, Los Angeles, the University of San Francisco School of Law, and Harvard. He served on Horace Mann Elementary's Principal's Advisory Council for two years, including as chair.

sentences.text: David Cienfuegos is a trial attorney at a personal injury law firm.
He says he holds degrees from California State University, Los Angeles, the University of San Francisco School of Law, and Harvard.
He served on Horace Mann Elementary's Principal's Advisory Council for two years, including as chair.

items.text: He advocates for rigorous instruction in reading, writing, math, science, history and critical thinking, plus tutoring and strong standards. He wants less classroom technology in TK-8 and supports the Wait Until 8th phone pledge. His plans include more honors, AP and dual enrollment courses, SAT and ACT prep, and an internship network. He supports phone-free school days for elementary and middle schoolers, and advanced AI education in high school.
